title: Anticoncentration for low degree functions
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with Fourier degree at most $k$, where $k\in\mathbb N$, and suppose $f$ is nonconstant. For uniformly random $x$ in the cube, $\Pr[|f(x)-\mathbb E f|>\frac12\sqrt{\operatorname{Var}(f)}]\ge \frac{9}{16\cdot 9^k}$.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
